install.title: Soundwatch install
install.step1: Power the unit on — the light should pulse red (setup mode).
install.step2: Join its WiFi network{ap, select, none { (Soundwatch-…)} other { — {ap}}} and enter this site's WiFi. If no setup page opens by itself, browse to http://192.168.1.1.
install.step3: Do not change the token field if the setup page shows one.
install.step4: Come back here — it can take a couple of minutes.
install.staleHint: It reported earlier and has now stopped. Check it still has power, then wait a minute.
install.gpsFailed: Could not read GPS. Allow location access, or pick a site from the list.
install.alreadyLocated: This device already has a location. Save again only if you are sure this is the right box.
install.pickSite: Pick the site you are standing at. Allowing location access sorts the nearest first.
install.occupiedWarning: This site already has a unit ({state, select, live {live} other {silent}}). Continue only if you are replacing it.
install.movePin: Move the map until the pin is where the unit is, then confirm.
install.pinConfirm: This is where the unit is
install.doNotLeave: Please do not leave until this page shows Receiving data.
